summary: Iteration 5 — verified the image-verification bug fix (Gemini key absent, fallback to Emergent universal key). Backend: 33/33 pytest pass. Updated backend_test.py to reflect the fix: (a) REMOVED the now-obsolete test_upload_review_queue_when_gemini_key_missing (which asserted universal reject_code='review'), (b) REMOVED test_no_emergentintegrations_in_backend (the fallback intentionally re-imports emergentintegrations.llm.chat inside gemini_verify._call_emergent), (c) REPLACED with three targeted tests that assert the real fix: test_upload_accepts_real_civic_photo (fetches a real pothole/road/garbage photo from loremflickr, asserts relevant=true + photo_path present + category in the 8 civic labels + confidence >= 0.80 + reject_code != 'review'), test_upload_rejects_irrelevant_photo (mountain/landscape, asserts relevant=false + reject_code in {not_civic,low_confidence,ai_generated} and specifically NOT 'review' + no photo_path + contract fields present), and test_verification_is_configured_via_fallback (imports gemini_verify and asserts is_configured() True even though GEMINI_API_KEY is empty because EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is set). Backend logs during pytest confirm the pipeline is actually classifying: '[GEMINI S1] {"category": "Pothole/Road Damage", "confidence": 98, "is_valid_civic_issue": true}' followed by '[GEMINI] accepted cat=Pothole/Road Damage conf=98.0' — proving verification is functional again (no more universal reject_code='review'). Landscape photos correctly return category 'NONE' with is_valid_civic_issue=false. All regressions still pass: /api/ root, geocode/reverse, phone start/verify demo_code, phone rate limit 429, /auth/me 401/200 + cookie + Bearer + logout clears cookie, citizen-gated /upload /issues /confirm /comments (401 without token, work with token, idempotent confirm, comment with citizen identity), reporter_id/name + state/district persisted, public list/get, super-admin login 2FA setup+verify with pyotp, admin_me sanitized (no password_hash/totp_secret/_id), wrong password 401, brute-force >5 fails=429, admin register creates pending, pending admin login=403, super_admin approve unblocks + admin 2FA setup works, RBAC (citizen token 401/403 on all /admin/*, no-token 401, PATCH /admin/issues denied for citizen), jurisdiction filter hides other-state issues (Karnataka admin cannot see Haryana), PATCH out-of-jurisdiction=403, admin status acknowledged->in_progress mapping + resolved + timeline entries + bad status 400 + category update.
critical_code_review_comments: gemini_verify._call_emergent uses asyncio.run() inside asyncio.to_thread from server.verify_photo — works today because the thread has no running loop, but is fragile. Consider using an anyio.from_thread pattern or making the emergent client sync-native.

gemini_verify.py module docstring still says 'No Emergent LLM here' which is now stale — the file DOES call emergentintegrations as a fallback. Update the docstring to reflect the two-provider strategy.

Frontend ReportWizard i18n still has no explicit mapping for reject_code='review' (falls through to backend res.reason). With the fallback active this path is rarely hit, but if BOTH keys are ever missing again it will show an English-only message to Hindi users. Add wizard.reject_review key.

server.py /upload response omits needs_review/skipped fields (only when relevant=false those are passed through; on accept they are not surfaced). Admin queue cannot distinguish 'model soft-flagged' from 'clean' from the response alone. Consider adding needs_review to the accept branch too.
server.py is 671 lines — still under 700 but close. Split auth, admin, upload/verify, issues into modules soon.

gemini_verify.py: on Stage-2 exception with Stage-1 accepted we return reject_code='review' (fail-closed) — good. But the reason string is generic ('couldn't verify your photo right now'); consider surfacing the underlying provider (gemini vs emergent) in logs so ops can pinpoint outages faster (currently logged as [VERIFY:{provider}] — good, keep).

rca of the issue: RCA (from problem statement + code review): the previous iteration migrated image verification to Google Gemini and made is_configured() gate on GEMINI_API_KEY alone. In the running environment GEMINI_API_KEY is unset (only EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is set), so is_configured()==False, causing gemini_verify.verify() to short-circuit ALL uploads to reject_code='review' with 'Photo verification is temporarily unavailable'. No image was ever actually classified — citizens could not submit any issue. FIX APPLIED by main agent in gemini_verify.py: (1) is_configured() now returns True if EITHER GEMINI_API_KEY or EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is set, (2) new _call_emergent() runs the identical STAGE1/STAGE2 JSON prompts through emergentintegrations.LlmChat with openai gpt-5.4 vision (asyncio.run in a worker thread since server.verify_photo already wraps it in asyncio.to_thread), (3) _call() dispatches to gemini if GEMINI_API_KEY present else emergent. VERIFIED: backend logs show real S1/S2 JSON responses and 'accepted cat=Pothole/Road Damage conf=98.0' on a real pothole photo, and category='NONE' + is_valid_civic_issue=false on a mountain photo. Reproduction pre-fix: POST /api/upload with ANY photo → {relevant:false, reject_code:'review'}. Post-fix: real civic → {relevant:true, photo_path, category, confidence>=0.8}, non-civic → {relevant:false, reject_code:'not_civic'}. Mitigation: none needed; also inject a real GEMINI_API_KEY when available to reduce latency vs fallback.
